notice.title: Complaint handling timelines
notice.aiSummary: Firms must acknowledge complaints within 2 business days and send a final response within 15 business days (reduced from 30 calendar days), and analyze complaint root causes quarterly. These requirements take effect on January 15, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to all firms that handle complaints from retail customers about banking, lending or payment products, and Brivanta Bank offers all three categories of products to retail and small-business customers.

text:
RETAIL CONDUCT AUTHORITY FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Complaint handling timelines
Notice number: RCN-2026-004
Issued by: Retail Conduct Authority
Published: 2026-09-01
Effective date: 2027-01-15
1. Who this applies to
All firms that handle complaints from retail customers about banking, lending or payment products.
2. Background
Customers wait too long for a final answer to their complaints. The Authority is shortening the maximum time allowed for a final response and asking firms to learn from the complaints they receive. The previous limit of 30 calendar days is withdrawn.
3. Requirements
3.1 A firm must acknowledge a complaint in writing within 2 business days of receiving it.
3.2 A firm must send the customer a final response within 15 business days of receiving a complaint.
3.3 A firm must analyze the root causes of complaints at least quarterly and report the findings to senior management.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-01-15.
Synthetic document written for a Snowflake example. The regulator, rule and numbers are fictional.

obligations.text: A firm must acknowledge a complaint in writing within 2 business days of receiving it.
obligations.controlDesc: Daily report of complaints not acknowledged within 2 business days, reviewed by the complaints manager
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CMP-01 requires "The complaints team acknowledges each complaint in writing within 2 business days" which exactly matches the obligation's 2 business day deadline, and Control CTL-101 generates a "Daily report of complaints not acknowledged within 2 business days" which would detect any breach of this specific obligation.

obligations.text: A firm must send the customer a final response within 15 business days of receiving a complaint.
obligations.controlDesc: Weekly report of complaints open for more than 30 calendar days without a final response, escalated to the head of Customer Care
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CMP-01 requires a final response within 30 calendar days whereas the obligation mandates 15 business days, which is a longer deadline that does not meet the requirement.

obligations.text: A firm must analyze the root causes of complaints at least quarterly and report the findings to senior management.
obligations.controlDesc: Quarterly complaint root cause pack presented to the Executive Risk Committee, with owners for each fix
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CMP-02 states "The complaints quality team groups complaints by product and cause every quarter" and "Findings and recommended fixes are presented to the Executive Risk Committee each quarter," which matches the obligation's requirement to analyze root causes at least quarterly and report findings to senior management, and Control CTL-103 confirms this by presenting the quarterly complaint root cause pack to the Executive Risk Committee.
